rulings.ruling: Ruling: ambiguity; amb.ny.2025.whole_dollars (owner decision C4; chosen reading: each computed tax, credit or worksheet line rounded half-up to the dollar where it is computed): IT-201-I p. 2, Entering whole dollar amounts, "When you enter amounts on your return, enter whole dollar amounts only." ... "Increase amounts that are 50 cents or more to the next dollar." IT-201-I (web edition), Tax computation worksheet 1, line 3, "Multiply line 2 by 5.5% (0.055)": $38,275 x 0.055: exactly $2,105.125, which the project rounds half-up to $2,105.00; the model's $2,105.13 is the same amount in cents. The model kept cents (the register's third reading, round only the final lines); the class M prompt carries neither the whole-dollar page nor the register entry (the tooling low in research/audits/ny/BUG-0424_lows.md). Recomputed from the source, not from the engine. Model value dropped from the fixture as not evidence.

Ruling: scope; the case pairs the worksheet 1 binding of ny_tcw_first (flat rate ny.tcw.first.rate, 5.5%, given to the model as "(3) The worksheet's flat rate ... 5.5%") with a single filer, a combination no return takes: IT-201 routes a single filer to worksheet 7 (forms/ny/2025/ny_it201.yaml, ny_it201.tcw.w7, rate ny.tcw.first.rate6), whose line 3 reads "Multiply line 2 by 6% (0.06)" (IT-201-I web edition, Tax computation worksheet 7). With the rate the case supplies, the definition's line is the project's (line 3 = $120,000 x 5.5% = $6,600; line 4, the single schedule on $120,000, = $4,271 + 6% x $39,350 = $6,632; line 5 = max(0, $6,600 - $6,632) = $0, so lines 8 = $0 and 9 = tax = $6,632). The model applied worksheet 7's 6% instead of the supplied rate; under 6% its figures are worksheet 7's ($7,200, $568, 0.4070, $231, $6,863), which is what IT-201 computes for this return through ny_it201.tcw.w7. Neither side is evidence for the bound definition: the job is a construction artifact of classm-jobs (instance binding chosen independently of the filing status; tooling low in research/audits/ny/BUG-0424_lows.md). Dropped from the fixture.
